run_rate_apply_batch: run rate_apply on a batch dict with text and audio columns to compute speaking rates and phonemes
run_rate_apply_single: run rate_apply on a single-row batch dict to compute speaking rate from text and audio duration
run_rate_apply_with_duration: run rate_apply on a batch with speech_duration field to compute speaking rates without decoding audio
run_rate_apply_list_text: run rate_apply on a batch where text_column_name contains a list of strings for multi-sample processing
run_rate_apply_custom_columns: run rate_apply with custom audio_column_name and text_column_name arguments for non-default column names
